views.name: chunk_view_0
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  debut,
  final_game
FROM player
WHERE debut IS NOT NULL
  AND final_game IS NOT NULL
views.description: Task: Compute the average single-player career span in years for all baseball players by computing, for each player, the difference between their debut date and final game date expressed as years + mo

views.name: chunk_view_0_1
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  'games played' AS stat_name,
  b.player_id,
  p.name_given AS given_name,
  b.g AS stat_value
FROM batting b
JOIN player p USING(player_id)
WHERE b.g = (SELECT MAX(g) FROM batting)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'runs' AS stat_name,
  b.player_id,
  p.name_given AS given_name,
  b.r AS stat_value
FROM batting b
JOIN player p USING(player_id)
WHERE b.r = (SELECT MAX(r) FROM batting)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'hits' AS stat_name,
  b.player_id,
  p.name_given AS given_name,
  b.h AS stat_value
FROM batting b
JOIN player p USING(player_id)
WHERE b.h = (SELECT MAX(h) FROM batting)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'home runs' AS stat_name,
  b.player_id,
  p.name_given AS given_name,
  b.hr AS stat_value
FROM batting b
JOIN player p USING(player_id)
WHERE b.hr = (SELECT MAX(hr) FROM batting)
